description: This file declares initialization and operation functions for the Ralink RT3052 Ethernet switch driver. It includes license information, conditional compilation directives, and function prototypes related to switch setup and status checking.

methods.name: int __init mtk_switch_init(void)
methods.description: Initializes the media switch; conditionally compiled based on CONFIG_NET_RALINK_ESW_RT3052.

methods.name: void mtk_switch_exit(void)
methods.description: Cleans up the media switch resources; conditionally compiled based on CONFIG_NET_RALINK_ESW_RT3052.

methods.name: rt3050_esw_init
methods.description: Initializes the RT3050 switch with given private data.

methods.name: rt3050_esw_has_carrier
methods.description: Checks for carrier presence on the RT3050 switch.
